profile_text.body:
# Zscaler

Zscaler is a public cloud enterprise security provider headquartered in San Jose, California, founded in 2007. The company describes itself as a leading provider helping global businesses adopt zero trust for secure digital transformation. Its unified cybersecurity platform, built on the Zero Trust Exchange, operates inline on connections to control access and eliminate attack surface. The platform addresses multiple security domains including data loss prevention, microsegmentation, secure access, and threat detection across users, data, and IoT/OT environments.

The company offers Zscaler AI, which it describes as a cloud security AI product built into its SSE platform for data loss prevention and AI traffic inspection. According to its site, the same platform that secures users and data also secures AI agents and models, and helps security operations teams stop threats at machine speed. The platform incorporates capabilities for AI asset management, attack surface management, and unified vulnerability management.

Zscaler is a publicly traded company on NASDAQ under ticker ZS (CIK 0001713683). The company maintains significant legal exposure in California, with 220 recorded cases in that jurisdiction as of the verification date in September 2026.
